$Comment: The hard daily: mithril gear taken apart at a Disenchanting Table. STATION_INPUT on '_Mithril' with CONTAINS, which catches every mithril piece whatever its class (the bar and the ore share the word but are never accepted by a table), carrying its own TextKey since the kind's default line would print the bare match string. Mithril is the finest vanilla gear, so three pieces is a real price. Qualifier 'Disenchanting_Table' with QualifierMatchMode PREFIX counts both tables and never the Sawmill. This file spells out its whole step and pay rather than inheriting a shared skeleton, so it loads with nothing but this pack, RPG Stations and the MMO installed; it hangs on the Daily board by id, and on a server with no board of that id it is simply never posted. The stations feature condition in Requires hides the contract rather than locking it: it is lifted out of the gate when the contract loads and the board's draw reads it live, so on a server where stations have been switched off the contract never takes a slot and is never posted, rather than being offered and refused at Accept.
